subject: Visibility add-ons: overage cushion + dashboard feature pack quote
messages:
From: Maya Patel <m.patel@skybridge.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@orchardhealth.io>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Visibility add-ons: retention and dashboard pack — ask for tailored quote

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the visibility features look promising. We're sizing commercial terms for a production rollout and need a tailored quote that covers three items together:

- Long-term retention: we need cold storage for traces/logs for 15 months, with ability to resurrect archived spans for debug.
- Tracing: 90d hot retention with full-span search and flamegraph exports.
- Advanced dashboards: 10 named dashboards, collaboration for 8 users, and two operational alerting integrations.

A couple of constraints from procurement:
- We prefer a single add-on SKU instead of three separate invoices if reasonable.
- We want an overage cushion for peak launches (approx 30% headroom) without surprise invoices for the first 90 days.
- Target start: January 2027; require final quote and SOW by 11/12 so we can include in our Q1 procurement packet.

Can you provide: a one-page price summary, an estimate of expected monthly ingest (you can use our approximate numbers below), and a short note on how retention + tracing will behave if we down-qualify to a smaller commit?

Rough usage: avg 120GB/day telemetry ingest, spikes to ~300GB/day during launches; ~250k spans/day.

Appreciate quick turn — procurement will want to see an anchored discount if possible.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Platform
Skybridge AI

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@skybridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: retention and dashboard pack — ask for tailored quote

Hi Maya — thank you for the clear brief and the usage numbers; that makes this much easier.

Short answer: yes, we can package retention + tracing + advanced dashboards into a single add-on SKU for contracting, and we can offer a 90‑day overage cushion for spiky launches with predictable amortization. I'll outline a compact response below and attach a one-page workbook for the numbers (visibility_requirements.xlsx).

Key points (provisional, subject to final commit size):
- Packaging: single Add-On SKU that maps to three feature flags (Retention-15m, Tracing-90d, Dashboards-Pro). We'll deliver one invoice line item and separate usage meterings in the Console.
- Cushion: 30% free headroom for the first 90 days after go‑live. After that, overages bill monthly with a tiered unit price.
- Pricing anchor: for the ingest/span profile you gave (120GB/day avg, ~250k spans/day), initial list is $14,200/month for the combined package (before discount). That includes archival storage, trace search indexes for 90d, and 8 editor seats plus 2 view-only seats for dashboards.
- Commitment levers: 12‑month committed path reduces list by up to 20%; 24‑month by up to 30% depending on usage smoothing guarantees.
- Down-qualification: if you choose a smaller commit mid-term we'll convert to month-to-month pricing at a known uplift (approx +18% on the committed price).

Next steps I'd propose:
1) You confirm whether SKUs should be a single line for procurement or if they need accounting detail broken out per feature.
2) If OK, I'll pull Sergio in with a draft pricing table and a preliminary SOW + DocuSign link.

I'm cc'ing my sales lead Sergio Alvarez so he can weigh onto discounts & SOW timing. Attached: visibility_requirements.xlsx (small workbook with rough math).

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@skybridge.ai>; Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: retention and dashboard pack — pricing table + proposed concession

Hi Maya — Sergio here (sales lead for this account). Appreciate the detail — Chloe's proposal aligns with how we typically structure these bundles. I've attached a spreadsheet with bracketed price points (redwood_visibility_pricing_table.xlsx). Key commercial proposal below: 

Proposal summary (final pricing delivered as a single add-on SKU on the quote):
- List: $14,200/mo (combined package) — Chloe's number.
- Standard concession: 15% off list for 12-month commit + 30% one-time POC credit applied to first invoice if you sign within 10 business days.
- Enhanced concession (requires PO + 12-month billing commit): 22% off list and an extended 60-day overage cushion for the initial ramp.
- Payment terms: Net 45 (we can accommodate Net 30 with finance approval).

Operational clarifications:
- Overage handling: spikes covered by cushion for the first 90 days (or 60 if the enhanced concession applies). After cushion, consumption is billed against the meter with a pre-agreed incremental rate — we'll include an example run-rate in the SOW.
- Dashboard seats: we can add temporary seats for onboarding for up to 30 days at no charge.
- Archival restore: archival retrievals over a 10GB/day threshold are billable; we discount retrievals for committed customers.

Lauren (cc) from RevOps: can you prepare a draft Quote + SOW for Deal SB-2026-7834 with the enhanced concession (22%)? If procurement signs quickly we'll add the one-time POC credit and the 60-day cushion.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_visibility_pricing_table.xlsx

From: Maya Patel <m.patel@skybridge.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons: retention and dashboard pack — pricing table + proposed concession

Thanks Sergio and Chloe — this is helpful and aligns with what procurement will need. We'll take the enhanced concession (22% off with PO + 12-month commit) and the 60-day cushion. Two asks before we route to legal: 

1) Please send a redlined SOW that includes the cushion language and a sample overage invoice table.
2) I'll need a one-line accounting breakout: total monthly charge (post-discount) and the line item label Redwood will use on invoices.

I've attached our PO template (Skybridge_PO_form.pdf). Procurement will prep the PO once we have the SOW and the DocuSign link.

If you can get the draft SOW and invoice line before EOD Tuesday (11/10) we'll include it in our procurement packet and aim to sign next week.

Best,
Maya
